title: 大石碎胸口
aliases: Wan Neng Qing Nian Lv Dian

cards.headline: Recorded in a rehearsal room that was a band member's old family home
cards.snippet: The band's debut album, which includes this song, was made in their rehearsal room, which had once been guitarist 董亚千's family home. It sat in an old four-storey red-brick building surrounded mostly by elderly neighbours who kept early hours. The band worked, joked and lived there day and night. The recording gear was borrowed and patched together, and the sessions dragged on for almost two years.

cards.headline: The empty lot outside the window became skyscrapers
cards.snippet: While the band recorded, a huge open lot appeared outside the studio window. Developers had marked it off, and at night it felt vast and mysterious, letting the wind blow harder. By the time the album was finished, tall buildings had filled the space. The band wrote that they hoped the record kept some trace of that emptiness, so listeners could stand side by side.

cards.headline: A fallen fisher king, passed out in a bathhouse
cards.snippet: One Genius reading takes the fisher king as Mao, powerless in Diaoyutai (the state guesthouse) after the Cultural Revolution failed. His fall is the "Blurred sunset in the front of chest", the sun-like figure now dimmed.
cards.context: One fan says the sung "在洗浴中心" always gives them a jolt, as if 董二千 were calling their name. A translator renders it "brothel".

cards.headline: The trumpet drop that hits like a punch
cards.snippet: 「背叛能讓你獲得自由」後面那小號跳出來的刹那，整個頭腦像是被狠狠的撞了一下
cards.context: Refers to the trumpet entering right after the lyric 'betrayal can set you free'.

cards.headline: A listener's wish, in memory of Dr. Li Wenliang
cards.snippet: 我只愿我们都没有听懂，2020/2/6日 悼念李文亮医生的离去 ，愿不再有人因饮食出卖风暴武器和喉咙。
cards.context: Dated 6 Feb 2020, the day after Li Wenliang's death; ties the lyric 'sell weapons, storm, throat for food' to him.
